test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

A. Some Cars are buses.

B. All trains are cars.

C. All planes are trains.

**Conclusions:**

1. All planes are buses.

2. Some cars are planes.
solution:
Statements:

A. Some Cars are buses.

B. All trains are cars.

C. All planes are trains.

The least possible Venn diagram;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/635f46802edf669834619d4745eed72b9ed5a1f88ebbe2b53e6b8f9dad379146.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All planes are buses. - **False **(Because, All planes are trains, All trains are cars and Some Cars are buses, So, all planes ca never be buses.)

2. Some cars are planes. - **True **(Because, All planes are trains, and All trains are cars, so Some cars are also planes)

So, Only conclusion 2 follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion 2 follows".**
